name: Seattle
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The SeattleData public parcel feature service is a City of Seattle-hosted layer sourced from King County assessor parcel polygons, spatially filtered to the City of Seattle Central Geographic Database extent. A bounded query at the ranked locator returned a polygon with only OBJECTID and PIN requested. This confirms a local parcel-map/record source for the point but does not establish citywide completeness or legal accuracy.
scopeLimits: 106 valid, distinct City of Seattle-hosted King County parcel references verified in thirteen bounded cells around the ranked WUP locator. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging, all 106 fresh PIN geometry reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32610 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The publisher describes its CGDB spatial extent, which extends north and south of Seattle; the source is not restricted to current municipal limits. Citywide completeness, legal survey accuracy and permanent PIN uniqueness beyond this sample are unverified.

executedQueries.query: Seattle official parcel GIS ArcGIS parcel boundaries city Seattle assessor feature service
executedQueries.scope: Trace Seattle/King County public parcel viewer to an anonymous vector geometry endpoint.
executedQueries.result: Official King County Parcel Viewer states it is sourced from the King County Assessor and supports parcel boundary selection. The Seattle-hosted ArcGIS item is owned by SeattleData and describes the layer as King County parcels clipped to the City of Seattle Central Geographic Database extent, updated weekly. A bounded point query at the ranked locator returned one Polygon with only OBJECTID and PIN requested.
executedQueries.method: English-language web search and direct public ArcGIS metadata/point query.

executedQueries.query: King County Parcel Viewer parcel boundaries Seattle public GIS polygon geometry API
executedQueries.scope: Confirm official viewer attribution, layer schema and safe vector query.
executedQueries.result: FeatureServer metadata reports Polygon geometry, WGS84 output support, OBJECTID transport ID and PIN native parcel identifier. At the WUP point the point-intersection query returned PIN 7974200250 / OBJECTID 11343910. No address/owner fields were requested.
executedQueries.method: Separate focused English-language search; ArcGIS REST item and layer metadata reviewed.
